mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reading_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND manga_id = #{mangaId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_progress (user_id, manga_id, chapter_id, image_index, page_index, total_images, progress_pct, last_read_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{mangaId}, #{chapterId}, #{imageIndex}, #{pageIndex}, #{totalImages}, #{progressPct}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_progress SET chapter_id = #{chapterId}, image_index = #{imageIndex}, page_index = #{pageIndex}, total_images = #{totalImages}, progress_pct = #{progressPct}, last_read_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND manga_id = #{mangaId}
